description: Rift 1.0.5 — Official Rebrand to Rift, Modern Red Accent Identity, Widget Visual Polish, and Comprehensive Performance Overhaul.

changelog.title: Official Rebrand to Rift & Visual Identity
items: Full application rebrand to Rift across launcher icons, splash screen, and interface typography, preserving complete update compatibility with applicationId = "com.napster.music".
Introduced the signature cassette tape logo featuring a vibrant red outline (#F20329) and white spools on a pitch-black background.
Adaptive and monochrome icon support for Android 13+ Material You themed app icons.
Immersive red ambient atmospheric glow on the Home screen, paired with crisp red accent typography (#FF4D68) and updated interactive controls.
Refreshed splash screen with high-fidelity uncompressed vector cassette rendering.

changelog.title: Home Screen & App Widget Visual Polish
items: Refined Dot Matrix, Vinyl Deck, and Dynamic Lyrics home screen widgets with high-definition XML preview layouts in the Android widget picker.
Smooth idle state rendering: displays elegant non-transparent fallback surfaces and uncompressed music icons when no track is currently playing.
Eliminated visual artifacting and bounding boxes on the Vinyl Deck turntable disc animation.
Harmonized aspect ratio and icon proportions on the Dynamic Lyrics widget.

changelog.title: Codebase Architecture & Namespace Migration
items: Migrated core application source code to Kotlin package namespace com.rift.music with zero disruption to Room database (song.db) or user settings.
Preserved all historical Room database schemas (1.json through 38.json) for seamless in-place schema discovery and migration.
Comprehensive documentation overhaul across all architectural guides, setup documentation, and licensing notices.

changelog.title: Speed Dial 5-Dot Random Discovery & Anti-Repetition Queue
items: Fixed Speed Dial matrix alignment: restructured the 5-dot Random button layout to mathematically match SpeedDialGridItem card dimensions, corner radius, and text baseline with a centered "Random" caption.
Implemented RandomDiscoveryQueue: instant preloaded playback (zero buffering delay) seeded by a randomly sampled track from genuine recent listening history (recentEvents(100)).

Strict anti-fatigue filtering: automatically excludes the user's top 30 most-played songs, recent 50 history events, and disliked songs, eliminating repetitive playback loops of the same 7-8 familiar tracks.
Atmosphere & genre matching: dynamically queries YouTube Related and Radio endpoints seeded by the selected song to preserve sonic character and tempo.

Novelty boost & diversity cap: prioritizes newer deep-catalog releases (2023+) and strictly caps artist representation to at most 2 tracks per artist across the queue, with seamless background pagination.

changelog.title: Adaptive Session Intelligence (ASI 1.0)
items: Engineered on-device recommendation intelligence modeling the listening session dynamically across 8 atmosphere profiles (Party, Workout, Relaxed, Romantic, Focus, Discovery, Commute, General).

Centralized feedback classification capturing explicit user commands across UI, MediaSession, notifications, and Bluetooth AVRCP (natural completion, intentional skip, manual track selection, replay).
Room DB historical event reconstruction: extracts authentic song metadata, artist names, timestamps, and completion rates from internal SQLite entities without seed assumptions.
Multi-source candidate generator with hard exclusion filters (dislikes, negative signal journal, active queue, cooldown) and canonical track identity resolution.
Bounded beam search sequence optimization (K=4, horizon H=5) with harmonic BPM matching, acoustic delta gating, and renormalized sparse acoustic dimensions.
Dynamic preference integration via EnableAsiAutoplayKey in DataStore with non-blocking fallback to baseline recommendations.

changelog.title: Settings > App Usage: Real-Time Performance & Data Telemetry Graphs
items: Overhauled Settings > App Usage to provide intuitive time-series visual graphs for CPU usage, GPU frame rendering/performance, and Network data consumption.
Tracks cellular and Wi-Fi data usage independently with total transferred megabyte accounting.
Renders smooth, flicker-free time-series metrics utilizing cubic Bézier path interpolation.
Eliminated redundant background polling daemons to maintain near-zero idle overhead.

changelog.title: Home Screen Header Refinement
items: Streamlined the top application bar on the Home screen to feature only the clean brand wordmark, removing the redundant top settings icon.
Maintained instant access to Settings via the persistent floating bottom navigation pill dock.

changelog.title: Home Screen: Speed Dial, Quick Picks & New Releases
items: Enabled Speed Dial and Quick Picks in the primary top tier of Home for immediate one-tap access to favorites.
Intelligent fallback populates Speed Dial from pinned favorites, heavy rotation, and discovery streams.
Added a dedicated New Release Albums horizontal carousel directly beneath Quick Picks for rapid browsing of fresh music.

changelog.title: Next Songs Recommendations & Algorithmic Auto-mix
items: Restored related track discovery and auto-mix recommendations by eliminating restrictive video-type filters.
Connected official YouTube radio stations (RDAMVM) ensuring continuous algorithmic recommendations and rich Similar Content queues.
Seamless automix refreshes dynamically on track transitions without interrupting playback.

changelog.title: Consolidated Audio Quality Controls
items: Unified audio quality settings into a clean, 2-tab bottom sheet with dedicated Wi-Fi and Phone Data preferences.
Streamlined quality options across Player, Settings, and Queue into a single coherent preference hierarchy.
Eliminated misleading terminology, clearly distinguishing user preferences from active stream and route telemetry.

changelog.title: Queue & Playlist Playback Enhancements
items: Fixed playlist playback to ensure true sequential playback starting from any randomly selected track.
Added one-tap Clear Queue action button directly in the Queue header with responsive feedback.
Integrated an accessible Autoplay toggle chip right into the Queue header row.

changelog.title: Direct Long-Press Queue Reordering & Media3 Shuffle Sync
items: Replaced the separate queue unlock button with direct long-press drag-and-drop reordering featuring elevation, haptics, and edge auto-scrolling.
Integrated Media3 shuffle-aware synchronization, updating DefaultShuffleOrder in-place without interrupting active playback or restarting songs.
Added TalkBack custom accessibility actions on queue items for keyboard and screen-reader users.

changelog.title: Persistent Disliked Songs & Restoration Management
items: Introduced Room database schema version 38 with a dedicated disliked_song table and composite index for cross-provider song exclusion.
Disliking a track immediately skips playback and permanently excludes matching tracks across queue continuation and automix.
Full parity across Player and Queue three-dot menus with reactive toggle cues, toast alerts, and persistent database synchronization.
Added a dedicated Disliked Songs management screen under Settings allowing one-tap restoration of disliked tracks.

changelog.title: Progressive Recommendation Selection & Autoplay Controls
items: Implemented a two-phase progressive recommendation algorithm with a 40-track cooldown window, mathematically guaranteeing fresh tracks precede recent tracks.
Maintains artist and album diversity across consecutive tracks with automated relaxation in Artist Radio mode.
Added an accessible Autoplay infinity toggle in Queue and Player controls with fallback to official YouTube Radio stations.

changelog.title: High-Capacity Spotify Public Playlist Import & Background Execution
items: Upgraded public Spotify playlist importer to paginate large playlists beyond 1,000 tracks via unauthenticated embed guest sessions and Pathfinder GraphQL.
Added 'Do in background' option in import progress dialog, allowing users to leave the app while the import finishes in an application-scoped supervisor coroutine.
Delivers an Android system notification ('Playlist Imports') and toast upon import completion with playlist title and total resolved songs.
Honors server Retry-After headers, automatically refreshes expired guest tokens on HTTP 401, and aborts cleanly on permanent 403 responses.
Preserves intentional duplicate playlist entries and exact track ordering without premature client deduplication.

changelog.title: Homepage 'More from this artist' & Content Settings Streamlining
items: Updated the 'More from this artist' homepage carousels to exclusively showcase other songs by artists the user listens to, directly querying artist discography and filtering explicit/video content per user preferences.
Removed legacy diagnostic logs section (playback logs and client probe dialogs) from Settings > Content.
Cleaned up the Misc category in Settings > Content by removing randomize home order and manual home feed arrangement toggles.

changelog.title: Playback Reliability, Error Recovery & Diagnostics Ring Buffer
items: Fixed intermittent playback halts caused by Media3 STATE_BUFFERING dropping user play intent during network quality and IPv6 stream reloads.
Resolved AudioTrack renderer recovery bug that paused playback upon sink reinitialization without resuming.
Fixed transient audio focus loss state capture so playback cleanly auto-resumes when audio focus is regained.
Ensured error recovery routines (expired URLs, 416 range errors, parsing errors, page reloads) resume playback when user intended to play.
Exempted external streaming providers (Tidal, Spine, JioSaavn, HTTP add-ons) from 10MB chunk truncation, preventing unexpected end-of-input mid-song.
Classified HTTP 410 (Gone) as an expired streaming URL alongside HTTP 403, triggering fresh URL resolution.
Added PlaybackDiagnostics in-memory circular ring buffer tracking the last 100 playback events for zero-overhead troubleshooting.

changelog.title: Search Screen History Tab & Album Tab Replacement
items: Replaced the redundant Album tab on the search page with a dedicated History tab.
Displays complete chronological search history with reactive updates from Room database.
One-tap search execution on any past query directly from the search screen.
Arrow fill button to load queries into the search bar for swift editing.
Individual item deletion and full history clear action with confirmation dialog.
Contextual empty state and pause-status indicator when search history is paused.
